tools.name: list_characters
tools.description: List the bitHuman house characters that can speak in a video: id, name, a short description and a picture.

tools.name: make_character_video
tools.description: Make a short video of one bitHuman house character saying the given words, in its own voice. Use a character id from list_characters. The text is said word for word: 3 to 200 characters, about 15 seconds of speech. Returns a video URL that plays inline, labelled AI character.

tools.name: talk_to_character
tools.description: Open a live voice conversation with one bitHuman house character in the chat. The character listens through the microphone and answers out loud for up to a minute. Use a character id from list_characters.

tools.name: report_widget_capabilities
tools.description: Used by the bitHuman widget only: records which display modes and browser features the host allows (booleans, no user data).
